attempts.detail: First new UI run started before installDist completed and used the old installed API. Build/test order corrected; no missing route is presented as a successful feature.

Initial report used a summary element outside the actual input catalogue and an exact-text assertion against full JSON. Replaced with a supported real button, explicit profile assertion and independent exact original-data/visibility audit.

A source panel closed during asynchronous map selection; the helper now waits for the new reference record and visible controls. A redundant report reload caused UnknownVizError during capture; capture uses the already verified document.

Legacy reports have no topology data. The private host now returns null for an empty topology block instead of attempting JSON.parse on empty text; published028 package is actually imported and physically played.
Partial nested reuse options now preserve every saved global default. Chat cannot relax an unrequested retained bound. Unit tests and actual changed-source reuse cover this behaviour.

1/12 baseline global acceptances versus5/12 finite-selector acceptances; all five accepted029 worlds pass native physics. Seven requests remain rejected. No frozen source, budget or threshold was tuned after inspection.

The old restart test gracefully closed Electron, which could allow a short native run to finish before shutdown. It now identifies only its own unique WorkspaceServer child and actually terminates it with SIGKILL before restarting. The unchanged interrupted-run/new-attempt assertions pass. Original independent failure and explicit-crash recheck are retained; no production physics or gates changed.

The copied live-test log describes a different uploaded PNG/palette. Actual029 sources are loaded through the real labelled-reference library and share the same two-colour palette. The verified differences are original PNG bytes, layout, seed and impulse direction. No palette-novelty assertion or photographic claim is made; original records remain intact.
